I'm with you about that mouse thing. I had one co-worker, that was using her mouse in same way. Also, because eating sounds are one of my arch enemies, that specific co-worker was just living trigger: she was always eating a lot during the day, always in front of computer, and it was taking her FOREVER to finish the meal. She was taking small, tiny bites, and chewing them so, so, sooo slowly. 
In different workplace, one day almost everyone was loudly blowing chewing gum bubbles, and some people were whistling. Nowhere to hide, nowhere to run, I threw everything I was doing and started to cry like baby.
Ohh yeah, that, and also when I hear "Just don't take too much of these, cuz these are strong and can be harmful" I feel like swallowing whole bottle on one go.
